translations: then surely We will give him life a life good
and We will pay them their reward
puzzle.hint: A beautiful divine promise that whoever does righteous deeds, male or female, while being a believer, will be granted a good life in this world and the best of rewards in the Hereafter.
puzzle.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةًۭ طَيِّبَةًۭ ۖ وَلَنَجْزِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
